title: Write a launch tagline and 50-word blurb for a budgeting app

spec.brief: Penny is a budgeting app for freelancers with irregular income. Write one tagline (at most 8 words) and a 50-word blurb for the launch page.
spec.rubric: Clarity (40): a freelancer understands the benefit at once. Voice (30): warm, not salesy. Fit (30): mentions irregular income; tagline at most 8 words; blurb 45-55 words.
